symptom: `combobox cb (Attribute: Flag)` on a Boolean, no data source, passed `mxcli check --references` and `exec`, then failed mxbuild with CE7247 "Only attributes of type Enumeration are allowed here." at Combo box 'cb' — and so did the same binding on String, Integer, Long, Decimal, AutoNumber, DateTime and Binary
cause: MDL-WIDGET39's attribute-type matrix covered the built-in inputs (CE2421) only; the pluggable combo box in enumeration mode writes its attribute to `attributeEnumeration`, whose template AllowedTypes is Enum alone, and nothing judged it
file: `mdl/executor/validate_widget_attribute_type.go` (`comboBoxEnumerationRule`, `inputAttributeRuleFor` — a combo box with an options data source is association mode and is skipped)
insight: The pluggable template states what a slot takes: `attributeEnumeration`'s ValueType.AllowedTypes is [Enum], and the combo box has a SEPARATE `attributeBoolean` slot (optionsSourceType `boolean`) that MDL never writes — so a Boolean combo box is not unsupported by the widget, only by the writer. Read AllowedTypes first, then measure: one combo box per type, each with its own name, on fresh 11.14.0 and 11.13.0 projects gave the same 8 CE7247s and a clean Enumeration control. The error code differs from the built-in inputs' (CE7247 vs CE2421) with the same message text, so the rule carries the code per widget. Lives in the --references tier with the rest of MDL-WIDGET39, so its bug-test is plain .mdl.
